description: M11 TR-17: the shipped bundle budget. kb compile fails at +20 % over bundleBytes; the compile test holds the packed bundle under bundleBytes and its gzip under bundleGzipBytes. Lowered from 1 MB to 720 KB in release 7 (perf/kb-slim): the packed codec (pack.ts) took the bundle from 1,023 KB to 574 KB, so this leaves about 25 % headroom for M5, M18 and M19. The compiled Knowledge Base ships only in the parse worker chunk.
